records.title: Dispatch Loom
records.subtitle: Dispatch reconciliation tool
records.summary: Internal dispatch-desk tool for reconciling records: operators compared an overnight spreadsheet with the daily export, and the tool surfaced understandable exceptions, including visible warnings for late source files and visible empty rows. Ada personally built the Python parser and SQL checks, gathered requirements, explained validation failures, and was responsible for those components. Operators and supervisors used the tool; supervisors made final dispatch decisions. It was not a route-optimization tool or an externally sold product.
records.source_quote: At Harbor Tools I personally designed and built Dispatch Loom, a dispatch reconciliation tool, using Python and SQL.
uncertainties: Grounding UNSUPPORTED: The record overstates preferences and requirements as implemented tool behavior: the source says supervisors wanted understandable exceptions and operators preferred a visible warning for late files, but does not establish that the tool surfaced those exceptions or implemented the warning.
